fixture: Claude Code on Vertex AI (Anthropic publisher wire)
why: phase 0 of the Vertex port: freeze the wire before implementing it. Requests are captured from the real client; responses are doc-derived until a live call is possible (the project's partner-model quota is zero).

upstream.note: the client appends /projects/... to ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL verbatim, so the /v1 segment must be in the base URL: Vertex serves /v1/projects/... and 404s the version-less path

artifacts.note: stored exactly as received; the client emits compact JSON with raw UTF-8, which JS re-serialization reproduces byte-for-byte, so the digest here (not the formatting) is what proves the fixture still matches the capture
